story.title: Our Heritage
story.content: Oak & Table was born from a simple desire: to bring the rich, comforting flavors of traditional Portuguese cooking into a modern, sophisticated setting. Located in historic Cascais, we source our ingredients locally and prepare every dish with respect for our culinary roots, paired with a curated selection of Portugal's finest wines.
